text: OnApplicationQuit can't await. Async save Tasks get killed mid-write when the process exits, so the quit path must call SaveSystem.SaveNow(), which is fully synchronous.
Saves are a plain File.WriteAllText to slotN.json, fast enough that we don't need anything fancier.

Atomic save: write slotN.json.tmp, then File.Replace(tmp, slotN.json, slotN.json.bak). File.Replace throws if the destination doesn't exist yet, so the very first save of a slot uses File.Move instead.

Save files are JSON via Newtonsoft (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json) with a SaveVersion int. Renaming a field means bumping SaveVersion and adding a step in SaveMigrations.cs; never change a [JsonProperty] name in place.

Tests from the command line: `Unity -batchmode -projectPath . -runTests -testPlatform EditMode -testResults edit.xml`; same with `-testPlatform PlayMode` (takes ~4 min). Close the editor first, batchmode refuses to open a project that's already open.
Application.persistentDataPath differs per platform. On Steam Deck under Proton it's inside compatdata/<appid>/pfx, so 'my save is missing' reports usually look in the wrong folder.
Steam Cloud uses Auto-Cloud configured in Steamworks; we don't call the remote storage API ourselves.
Moved off Auto-Cloud to ISteamRemoteStorage calls in SteamCloudSync.cs so we decide when uploads happen. Auto-Cloud was uploading half-written files at exit.
Run Addressables > Build before making a player build, otherwise new enemy prefabs show up as missing references in the build.
Rebinding UI stores Input System overrides as JSON in PlayerPrefs under 'bindings'. The debug menu's PlayerPrefs.DeleteAll wipes them too.
Unity version is pinned to 2022.3.42f1 in ProjectVersion.txt. Open with exactly that version in Unity Hub; an upgrade reimports everything (~40 min) and dirties hundreds of files.
Git LFS tracks *.png, *.wav, *.fbx (run `git lfs install` once). UnityYAMLMerge is set up in .gitattributes for .unity and .prefab.
Room generation is seeded from the run seed; DungeonGen.Debug.DrawGizmos shows the room graph in the Scene view.
Combat GC spikes came from LINQ in EnemyAI.Update. No LINQ or string concat in per-frame code; use the pooled lists in Core/ListPool.
System.IO.Hashing isn't available in Unity's .NET profile, so we vendored Core/Util/Crc32.cs. SaveSerializer writes the CRC of the JSON payload in the header line and checks it on load.
Only run tests from the Test Runner window; batchmode CLI runs fail with our assembly definitions.
UI strings go in the 'UI' string table of the Localization package, keys in SCREAMING_SNAKE.
Save bug repro karna ho toh 'Saving...' icon dikhte hi Task Manager se game kill karo. Alt+F4 se OnApplicationQuit chal jaata hai, us se bug repro nahi hota.
C# style: _camelCase private fields, [SerializeField] private instead of public fields, one MonoBehaviour per file named after the class.
Switch port is parked. Ignore the #if UNITY_SWITCH blocks, they don't compile without the SDK.
FMOD banks live in Assets/StreamingAssets. After changing events in FMOD Studio, build banks to that folder or the game plays silence.
Boss balance sheet Google Sheets se CSV export hota hai, Tools > Import Balance CSV chalao. ScriptableObjects haath se edit mat karo, next import overwrite kar dega.
Steam builds: Tools > Build > Steam (Windows + Linux), then build/upload_steam.sh uploads to the 'beta' branch with steamcmd. Set live from the Steamworks site.
GameBootstrap creates SaveSystem first and hooks both Application.quitting and OnApplicationQuit, because on some platforms only one of them fires. The handler must be idempotent.
